mapper.select: SELECT count(distinct u.user_sq) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(u.access_log_connected_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_USER_ONLINE_S u WHERE DATE(u.access_log_connected_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(u.access_log_connected_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.project_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_PROJECT_M t WHERE DATE(t.project_created_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.project_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.project_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H t WHERE DATE(t.project_application_created_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.project_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.company_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_COMPANY_APPLICATION_H t WHERE DATE(t.company_application_created_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.company_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.board_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_BOARD_M t WHERE t.board_type_cd IN (1401, 1402, 1403) AND DATE(t.board_created_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.board_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.comment_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S t WHERE DATE(t.comment_created_at_dtm) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.comment_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(distinct u.user_sq) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(u.access_log_connected_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_USER_ONLINE_S u WHERE u.access_log_connected_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(u.access_log_connected_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.project_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_PROJECT_M t WHERE t.project_created_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.project_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.project_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H t WHERE t.project_application_created_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.project_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.company_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_COMPANY_APPLICATION_H t WHERE t.company_application_created_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.company_application_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.board_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_BOARD_M t WHERE t.board_type_cd IN (1401, 1402, 1403) AND t.board_created_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.board_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT count(*) AS count, DATE_FORMAT(t.comment_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d") AS date FROM TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S t WHERE t.comment_created_at_dtm >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.comment_created_at_dtm, "%Y-%m-%d")

SELECT t.board_sq AS id, t.board_ttl AS title, m.user_nm AS name, t.board_comment_cnt AS comments, DATE_FORMAT(t.board_created_at_dtm, "%H:%i") AS time FROM TBL_BOARD_M t LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_M m ON t.user_sq = m.user_sq WHERE t.board_is_deleted_yn = 'N' AND t.board_type_cd IN (1401, 1402, 1403) ORDER BY t.board_created_at_dtm DESC LIMIT 5
